text:
Tasha: Heads-up — cutting v1.12.3 tomorrow at 22:00 UTC (T+1h). Need a second eye on PR #8123 before the cutoff. It contains the kv-cache memfix and a small GC tweak. Blocking until we have 2 approvals and a quick smoke pass. @Kevin @Jen can you please take a look?

Kevin: On it, starting a local smoke + perf run now. :eyes:

Sanjay: Skimming the diff — leaving one tiny comment about the nil-check on the fallback path, not blocking though. Will post the exact line in PR.

Jen: I can do the second LGTM if the smoke doesn't show regressions. Ping me when CI is green. :thumbsup:

Tasha: CI flaky test (integration/test_cache_eviction) is showing up in the matrix, I've retriggered. If it keeps flaking we may need to decide to bypass that test for this cut (prefer not). FYI the change is low-risk for integration surface.

deploy-bot: CI: build 987 for PR #8123 — all checks passed (rerun). Summary: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e flaky-run fixed.

Kevin: CI green here and local smoke passed. Verified basic request/response and kv warmup. Left LGTM on PR.

Jen: Quick perf sanity on staging (canary build) looked fine. Leaving LGTM as well — will monitor metrics post-deploy. LGTM :white_check_mark:

Tasha: Perfect — we have two approvals. Plan: merge at 22:05 UTC, tag release, push to canary for 15m, then ramp if no regressions. Will watch latency/5xx closely. If anyone wants to abort, shout now.

Oliver: I’ll take post-deploy on-call for the first 30 minutes. If error rate > 0.5% or tail latency > 2s I'll trigger rollback.

Tasha: Merging now. Merge command used: ```
git checkout main
git merge --no-ff origin/pr/8123 -m "chore: kv-cache memfix (pr #8123)"
git push origin main
```

deploy-bot: Deploy: starting canary rollout for v1.12.3 -> canary (us-west-2). Instance set: 3 -> 10% traffic.

Kevin: Observing canary logs — no OOMs, mem footprint stable.

deploy-bot: Canary health checks passed. Promoting to 50% traffic.

Tasha: Thanks all. I'll keep an eye on dashboards for the next hour and post a short follow-up. If anything spikes, tag @Oliver and we’ll rollback.

Oliver: Copy. Standing by.

deploy-bot: Deploy: v1.12.3 promoted to 100% traffic — rollout complete.
